newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Cult leader Sung Chi-li admits hoax.
Pro-democracy leader Wang Xizhe flees China, seeks asylum in U.S.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Sung Chi-li arrested on extortion charges.
Second U.S.-Taiwan trade framework talks to be held in Taipei.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry to revise depreciation allowance for manufacturers.
Five Nationalist Party-controlled groups acquire 10 percent of San-yang Securities.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - New tobacco import duties proposed to be capped at 35 percent and those for liquor at 25 percent.
M2 growth seen 8.5 percent in September.
